title: Line bundles extend across discrete retrocompact complements with Noetherian local rings of dimension at most one
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs local equations that isolate each missing point even when the ambient scheme is not globally Noetherian. It glues these equations to a line bundle realizing the open complement and uses triviality of Picard groups on localized Artinian rings to extend arbitrary line bundles from that open.
